scripts.check:precommit: bun run check:e2e-rules && bun run check && bun run build
scripts.test:e2e: bun run build && mkdir -p .e2e && go build -o .e2e/arknova ../cmd/arknova && playwright test && git diff --exit-code -- tests/e2e
scripts.test:e2e:update-snapshots: bun run build && mkdir -p .e2e && go build -o .e2e/arknova ../cmd/arknova && playwright test --update-snapshots
